page.overview:
Who is Asa Negra?

Considered a madman by the Commandos, Asa Negra is specialist in night flights... with a glider! Only he is so irresponsible to fly at darkness fully guided just by intuition and evil. For him, it's the same be it day or night. Hidden at darkness, practically invisible, Asa Negra can commit atrocities 24 hours a day! (filecard translation)

Asa Negra is a mercenary working for Cobra in Brazil. The name Asa Negra is Portuguese for "Black Wing". A team of Joes found that Asa Negra had been killed in Brazil by an unknown assassin.

Asa Negra was a G.I. Joe action figure released in Brazil with the same mold of the Headhunter Stormtrooper.
